brightnessProxy: Minimum across the two frames and the two greens of the background-subtracted peak divided by the robust annular background scale. This is a peak-to-background-noise proxy, without a source shot noise model.
weightedFit: Use the squared proxy ratio relative to the median proxy of training stars, clipped to [1/4,4]. Compare to unit weights on exactly the same stars.
diagnostic: Split held-out stars at the median proxy of the training stars and report P90 for each group with at least ten held-out stars. Use all held-out stars for threshold decisions.
